sections.content:
You can describe where an object or gift originated using origin suffixes:
- *Egy ajándék Pécsről* (A gift from Pécs)
- *Egy bor Tokajból* (A wine from Tokaj)
- *Egy könyv a boltból* (A book from the shop)

items.english: This is a lovely gift from Pécs.
I brought delicious paprika from Szeged.
